admin_intro: Manage project content and workflows in clearly separated modules. This area grows incrementally with demonstrated requirements.
admin_stories_description: Manage narrative content and place catalogued resources in a readable context.
admin_staging_description: Explore existing project staging areas and their folders.
admin_resources_description: Review and edit metadata of existing resources.
admin_resources_intro: Find existing resources and edit their basic metadata as defined by the live data model.
admin_resources_load_error: The editable resources could not be loaded.
admin_resources_empty: No supported resource readable by you was found.

admin_resource_editor_required: At least one value is required for every mandatory field.
admin_resource_editor_text_intro: All language variants are preserved; this view edits the selected language.
admin_resource_editor_relations_intro: Available targets and cardinalities come from the current OLDAP data model.
admin_resource_editor_multi_hint: Use Shift or Command/Ctrl to select several values.
admin_resource_editor_scope_note: This first editor changes only title, description, and simple forward relations. Media facts, rights, dating, inverse links, and archive placements remain untouched.
admin_access_description: Manage project roles, access permissions, and publication workflows.
staging_intro: Existing staging areas with their folders and staged media objects. Individual images can be uploaded safely into one selected folder.
staging_error: The working areas could not be loaded.
staging_empty_text: This project has no staging area visible to you yet.
staging_folders_error: The folders could not be loaded.
staging_folders_empty: This working area has no visible folders yet.
staging_children_error: The folder contents could not be loaded.
staging_upload_hint: A deliberately small first step: JPEG, PNG, HEIC, or HEIF. Metadata follows during cataloguing.
staging_upload_success: {name} was uploaded and verified in OLDAP.
staging_upload_error: The image could not be uploaded.
staging_upload_readback_error: The image was transferred but could not be read back completely from OLDAP.
staging_discard_confirm: Really remove {title} from the working area? The OLDAP record and all associated media files will be deleted.
staging_discard_success: {title} was removed from the working area.
staging_discard_cleanup_pending: The record was deleted; internal file cleanup is still pending.
staging_catalogue_intro: Choose a media class allowed by the project model and enter its minimal metadata. The IRI, media file, checksum, and IIIF delivery are retained.
staging_catalogue_loading: Loading suitable target classes from the data model …
staging_catalogue_no_targets: The project model does not yet contain a media class whose required fields can be completed by this small form.
staging_catalogue_error: The media object could not be catalogued.
staging_catalogue_success: The media object was catalogued as {title} and removed from the working area.
staging_batch_intro: Choose one target class and language. The description applies to every selected medium; each suggested title can be edited before preview.
staging_batch_description_hint: This value is applied unchanged to every medium in the batch.
staging_batch_relations_hint: Optional values are derived from the project model and applied to every selected medium.
staging_batch_relations_error: The selectable resources could not be loaded.
staging_batch_preview_intro: Review the complete assignment. OLDAP will then process each medium individually and SALSAH stops at the first error.
staging_batch_workspace_success: {count} media were catalogued as {title} and removed from the working area.
staging_batch_workspace_partial: {completed} of {total} media were catalogued; the batch stopped at the first error.
admin_stories_intro: Edit existing Stories defined by the project model. Creation, publication, and deletion follow as separate increments.
admin_story_create_intro: Create the minimal private record. SALSAH then opens the new Story directly in the Markdown editor.
